title: Use the Clinic KPIs report
summary: The clinic's main numbers on one board.

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Clinic KPIs
steps.details: The clinic's main numbers on one board.

steps.title: Period
steps.details: Today, this week, this month, last month, this year or your own range.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: Only if the clinic works with two currencies: all or one.

steps.title: Generate
steps.details: Calculates the report with the chosen filters.

steps.title: No data
steps.details: There's no data for those filters: try another period.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.details: Production, collections, patients, appointments and other indicators for the period.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Sort by column by tapping the header.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Excel, CSV or PDF with what you're viewing.
